stem: Determine whether each action was a cause or an effect of bank failures during the Great Depression.
instruction: Select the correct answer in each row.

options.text: Many people lost their life savings.
Financial institutions were closed to determine their stability.
Financial institutions lacked cash reserves because they had invested deposits.
Businesses were unable to take out loans.
